topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern, with multiple investigations and cases being reported across the country. The FBI has released details on motives in a Michigan synagogue attack, which was inspired by Hezbollah. Additionally, a Medicaid fraud investigation is targeting Fishing Point Healthcare, and a woman in Hortonville has pleaded not guilty to alleged $58,000 FoodShare and child care fraud plot.
